message.content: Based on the conversations shared, LiHua has given positive feedback on Hailey's artisanal donuts. Specifically, LiHua tried several of the new donuts and found them "amazing," appreciating the unique and delicious flavors. When asked which flavor was his favorite, LiHua specifically mentioned he loved the chocolate hazelnut donut, noting that it had a "perfect balance of sweetness." He expressed enthusiasm for the donuts, stating, "I really loved the chocolate hazelnut one! It had the perfect balance of sweetness. Can't wait to see what you come up with next!" This feedback highlights the success of the chocolate hazelnut donut and indicates that it is a standout among the artisanal donuts. LiHua also suggested adding a seasonal fruit flavor, such as raspberry or lemon, as a potential addition to the lineup, further emphasizing his satisfaction with the current offerings.
